spans.label: imports (plonky2 verifier data, cyclic and dummy helpers)
spans.note: Semantics supplied by plonky2/imported crates; opaque to the model.

spans.label: add_proof_target_and_verify: verify under a constant verifier key
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify
spans.note: This variant emits NO binding between the constant key and the key the proof carries in its own public inputs. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: add_proof_target_and_verify_cyclic: connect the embedded verifier key
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify_cyclic
spans.note: The key binding is conditional: with the condition clear the embedded key is unconstrained and the proof is verified under the dummy key. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

boundaries.name: proofVerificationOpaque
boundaries.obligation: Recursive verification is recorded as a constraint; nothing about proof soundness is claimed.

boundaries.name: capCountFromPlonky2Config
